A ride uploaded by either platform still opens correctly on intervals.icu, on Strava and in Garmin Connect, with its laps as laps.

ISS-0290.title: LTHR field on Rider Profile did not always re-derive when Max HR changed. Fixed 2026-06-08 with a 400ms debounce on the save effect plus removal of the LTHR derive effect's `currentUser.maxHeartRate` fallback (strict derivation from the field only).

Affected every interval (warmup, each rep, recovery, cooldown). Rider reported on the Anaerobic 8×30s workout: the warmup's `Easy spin — let the legs wake up gradually.` cue never appeared. Fixed 2026-06-08 (CHG-20260608b) with a `fireImmediateCuesForCurrentInterval()` helper called at every interval-boundary site.

ISS-0292.title: Coaching cues lost on YT → intervals.icu → YT round-trip — IntervalsIcuDslWriter never emits cue text on publish, and IntervalsIcuDslParser silently dropped the `<text><!>` rider-facing prefix on parse (documented as 'cue / coaching note, not load-bearing' but actually IS load-bearing in YT's workout model).
